summary: Indonesia Energy Corp Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing that rig mobilization is complete for the K-29 well, the first of two planned wells in 2026 at the Kruh Block. No special-situation event occurs: the filing is a routine operational update with no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, management change, or other corporate event. The registrant is merely reporting drilling progress. There are no deal terms, premium, board recommendation, or financial advisor. This is an ordinary operational milestone report under Rule 13a-16.
